items.title: Theo (@theo)
items.summary: OpenAI works in a single giant monorepo on GitHub. Seems like they’re running into git perf issues at their size and velocity. Super cool to see them upstreaming fixes to git itself Ted Nyman (@tnm) happy friday we've continued our work on git here at @openai . performance, correctness, & testing improvements are flowing from openai/git to upstream. perf improvements in codex app too; you'll see more efficient use of git in new builds. follow along: openai-git-upstream.openai.c… Link OpenAI Git · patches & notes OpenAI's Git patches for large repositories, tracked from local topic branches through seen, next, and upstream master. openai-git-upstream.openai.chatgpt.site — https://nitter.net/tnm/status/2083328099975119044#m
